schema.loaded_by: src modules reachable from src/main.js that fetch or import the file at runtime; empty means studio/dev/source only
schema.ue_content_path: proposed per-asset content FOLDER; import_assets.py imports each source into that folder
schema.units: glTF: metres, +Y up, ships nose -Z; Interchange converts to centimetres, Z-up automatically

conventions.coordinates: metres, Y up; ships nose -Z, aft +Z; origins documented per entry (landing plane, support surface, base centre)
conventions.named_nodes: node names gameplay looks up (getObjectByName / layout.json); they must survive as components or sockets
conventions.colour_spaces: basecolor/emissive sRGB; normal (OpenGL +Y), ORM, bump, roughness linear
conventions.vertex_colours: COLOR_0 carries baked AO / tint on base kit, station and ship exports; keep it on import

extensionsRequired contains EXT_texture_webp (every textured GLB). Unreal Interchange glTF has no WebP image decoder as far as this audit knows; import will either drop textures or refuse the file. Mitigation: re-export from the .blend/builder with PNG images, or round-trip through Blender (import GLB, export GLB with PNG) before running import_assets.py. assets.notes: Starter ship (Meridian Nomad). Original Blender geometry; Meshy texture pass cleaned by assets/ship/clean_meshy_upload.py, packed by assets/ship/pack_nomad.py (record: assets/ship/runtime-manifest.json, 3413568 bytes = current file). Origin: hull datum at deployed foot contact plane, nose -Z. Material names are contracts too: "Drive / ion blue" (src/effects/engine-state.js, src/ship-walkable.js). Studio loaders: src/ship-studio.js, src/build/studio.js, effects/lab.js. HP_Weapon_* are S1 weapon sockets (docs/weapon-mount-standard.md): mount plane origin, normal +Y, bore -Z. Runtime adds hatch, folding ramp, MFDs and cargo screen procedurally (src/ship-walkable.js), they are not in the GLB.
Editable Blender source for nomad.glb (saved by the builder). Not importable by Interchange; import the GLB.

64 m Atlas Mark II freighter (hero LOD0). Contract: assets/atlas-mark-ii/layout.json (imported at runtime by src/atlas-mark-ii-systems.js) plus interior-colliders.json and mount-standard.json (src/weapon-mounts.js). Exported by assets/atlas-mark-ii/export_atlas.py, packed by pack_geometry.py; textures built by build_textures.py into public/textures/atlas-mark-ii and embedded as WebP. Origin: landing contact plane, ship centre, nose -Z. Ramps are hinge nodes with tip and header-seal children; landing gear legs have pad/bay/door children; Mount_S3_* are size-3 weapon mounts; PilotMFD_* are display quads. Studio: src/atlas-mark-ii-studio.js, src/build/studio.js.

Single-seat interceptor. RUNTIME ASSET THAT LIVES OUTSIDE public/: src/main.js imports it with Vite `?url` so the bundle serves it. Contract: assets/kestrel/contract.json (hardpoints HP_* size 2, 12 RCS_* sockets, PilotEye), assets/kestrel/flight-layout.json (imported by src/kestrel-access.js). Aeon orbital hangar pod (hero). REQUIRED_NODES in src/station.js: HangarDoor_L, HangarDoor_R, LandingDeck, LandingPad, ApproachPoint, DoorTrigger. Animation "DoorsOpen" drives the hangar doors. LandingDeck must stay a single measured mesh (docs/asset-production-standard.md). Material names NavLight_Red, NavLight_Green, Beacon_White are emissive contracts. Floor is at Y=-8 in the pod frame; station-complex clones the pod into POD_LAYOUT positions. Record assets/station/hull-manifest.json is self-declared historical (its hashes do not match the current 3807800-byte file).
Distant stand-in beyond 25 km with the same DoorsOpen clip; door positions are mirrored from the hero each frame.

Four-unit retail promenade aft of the concourse (PR #117), Cosmic Chicken galley print anchors receive the WebP posters in public/textures/station.

Hangar dressing (cargo dolly, strapped pallet, bench dress, ...) batched into nine material meshes; assembly names in assets/station/props-manifest.json are NOT node names in the runtime file. Identity placement on the hangar hero root; not copied into the LOD.
